text:
owen: Heads-up — branch freeze for v1.8.0 at 18:00 UTC today. We need final version bumps, changelog entries, and docs/site work merged before cutoff.

sasha: Quick Q — who’s owning the SDK docs regen? I can pair if someone already started.

jules: I kicked off the SDK regen pipeline earlier, but hit a docs linter error on the staging build. Holding there for now.

jules: build log snippet:
```
$ make docs-build && ./scripts/regenerate-sdks.sh
ERROR: docs/clients/python/README.md:42: missing code example block for `Client.create`
make: *** [docs-build] Error 1
```

ci-bot: CI:sdk-docs #342 failed — linter error reported. Full details: https://ci.internal/reports/342 (logs attached)

kevin: Okay — jules, can you PR a temporary example or a TODO comment so we can unblock release? We can clean up afterward in a follow-up. Also remind everyone to add changelog lines to the release-notes.md under the "Unreleased" section.

jules: Will do a tiny fix PR now. tagging @sasha for quick review since it touches python example style.

sasha: On it. If it's just a placeholder example I can approve fast. Also, is there a specific version-bump policy for this release? patch/minor?

kevin: v1.8.0 — minor bump. We bumped a few public SDK signatures so follow semver-minor. Please update package.json / setup.cfg / pyproject as appropriate and include the new version in the changelog header.

owen: Also callout — console feature-flag rollout is scheduled for the same window. If docs site deploy slips past 19:00 UTC we risk config drift for the public docs. Try to keep docs deploy <= 18:50 UTC.

jules: PR opened: https://repo.internal/pulls/2189 — small example added, docs linter should pass after CI retest. Marking as release-blocker until merged.

ci-bot: CI:sdk-docs #343 queued — waiting for reviewer.

sasha: Reviewed and left one tiny nit, nothing blocking. Approving after fix. :thumbsup:

jules: Fixed nit, pushed. CI passing now.

ci-bot: CI:sdk-docs #343 passed — docs build succeeded.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved: 2026-03-17T19:00:00Z — 2026-03-17T19:30:00Z (docs-site-prod).

kevin: Great — I'll handle the changelog merge and version bump PR to `release/v1.8.x` now. Folks: please don't force-push `release/v1.8.x` after 18:00 UTC.

owen: Thanks everyone. jules, please trigger the docs-site deploy once release branch contains the changelog/version bump. I’ll monitor console rollout.

jules: Will trigger deploy and post status here when live.

deploy-bot: docs-site deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/v1.8.0 at 2026-03-17T19:07:12Z — status: success.

kevin: Release branch tag created: v1.8.0 — changelog included. Moving to post-release checklist. :tada:

owen: Closing thread — if anything else pops up ping in #eng-oncall. Nice work.
